docs: Stories content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of one to six stories (posts), each with a cover picture, a title, a line and an address. One object is valid in every stories layout (columns, a featured story, compact rows, alternating rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

stories.docs: the stories, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the cover picture; none: the placeholder

description.docs: one line about the story; empty: none

href.docs: the address of the story; none: the title is plain text
